description: This file defines the OrganizationStructureController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, responsible for handling the organization structure view in the web application. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for rendering the organization structure UI.

classes.name: OrganizationStructureController
classes.description: Controller class for managing organization structure view, extending AbstractVueController, and preparing the Vue component for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by creating and setting the 'organization-structure' Vue component.
